pdf: Once upon a time a lazy boy lived with his mother near the market. Every morning he ran through the streets, and his mother called him a good-for-nothing. She was often hungry and very unhappy, because the boy never helped her.

One day an old man came to the market. "Is your name Aladdin?" he asked. "I am your father's brother, and I want to help you." He gave the boy ten pieces of gold and a new coat. The boy was very surprised, but he took the gold home.
The old man was not his uncle.
He wanted to find a magic lamp.
Only a poor boy could get into the garden.
captions: The old man went up to an orange-seller.
